# ECN-2026-020 - Change notice - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-HT02

Reason for change
-----------------
Background: Routine maintenance reviews and recent audit findings identified inconsistent tracking of thermocouple drift on Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02). Calibration records in MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2 indicated variable intervals between verifications, and operators reported uncertainty about when the next verification was due. To reduce process variability and ensure metallurgical conformance for parts processed on line P2-L4, a formal standardized calibration interval is required for the furnace thermocouples.

Rationale: Establishing a documented thermocouple calibration interval reduces risk of undetected measurement drift, improves repeatability of heat treat cycles, and aligns maintenance activity with procedural expectations referenced in SOP-P2-L4-01 and SOP-P2-L4-02. The chosen interval balances equipment reliability and workload on the maintenance team while being short enough to detect drift before it impacts product quality. This change closes a gap observed during the recent maintenance review and supports traceability of calibration activities.

Affected items
--------------
Scope: This change applies to the thermocouple sensor array and associated calibration records for EQ-P2-L4-HT02. Affected records include the on-equipment calibration log, the maintenance master record MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2, and any process run sheets that reference thermocouple verification status in SOP-P2-L4-01 and SOP-P2-L4-02.

Specifics: The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 55 days. All calibration events recorded for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 must reference MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2 and be cross-referenced on the daily control log used by operators under SOP-P2-L4-01. Any nonconforming readings discovered during calibration must be dispositioned according to the escalation path in SOP-P2-L4-02.

Implementation
--------------
Overview: Implementation will be coordinated between Maintenance, Heat Treat Operations, and Quality. The change will be applied to the calibration scheduling system, the maintenance master record MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2, and to the procedural steps in SOP-P2-L4-01 and SOP-P2-L4-02 where calibration status is checked prior to processing.

Stepwise actions:
- Update MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2 to include the new thermocouple calibration interval and to include a field for next due date. Maintenance planners will populate the next due date at the time of each calibration event.
- Update the pre-run checklist in SOP-P2-L4-01 to require verification of calibration status for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 before authorizing the start of any heat treat cycle. Include instruction that the on-equipment log must be present and that the last calibration entry must reference MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2.
- Update the escalation and disposition steps in SOP-P2-L4-02 to define actions when a thermocouple fails calibration. Required actions include tagging affected thermocouples, logging the event, and notifying Quality for potential hold on affected lots.
- Configure the electronic maintenance scheduling tool to generate reminders aligned with the calibration interval for EQ-P2-L4-HT02. Maintenance will acknowledge reminders and attach a completed calibration certificate to MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2.
- Conduct a short training brief for Maintenance and Operations staff to review the new interval and the updated checklist items in SOP-P2-L4-01 and SOP-P2-L4-02. Training attendance will be recorded and retained with change implementation records.

Examples of expected behavior:
- When a calibration is completed on EQ-P2-L4-HT02, the technician will enter the calibration result in MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2, sign the entry, and schedule the next calibration according to the interval specified above. Operators will confirm calibration status during pre-run checks per SOP-P2-L4-01.
- If a thermocouple is found out of tolerance during calibration, Maintenance will tag the sensor as out of service, document the corrective action in MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2, and follow the hold and disposition steps in SOP-P2-L4-02 before returning the furnace to production.

Records to keep
---------------
Retention: All calibration records for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 must be filed in MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2 and maintained in the quality record system referenced by SOP-P2-L4-02. Records from the pre-run verification in SOP-P2-L4-01 shall be retained with the affected job traveler and linked to the lot history.

Minimum documentation for each calibration event:
- Completed calibration certificate attached to MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2.
- Technician name and signature on the calibration entry.
- Date of calibration and the next due date populated per the interval.
- Any deviation or corrective action noted and cross-referenced to SOP-P2-L4-02 when applicable.
- Training acknowledgment for personnel performing or verifying calibration checks.

Audit and verification
----------------------
Quality will include verification of compliance with the new calibration interval during planned audits and when reviewing process capability data for heat treat operations on line P2-L4. Audit checks will include review of MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2 entries and cross-reference to pre-run checks in SOP-P2-L4-01. Discrepancies will be handled following SOP-P2-L4-02.

Approvals
---------
Requested approvers: Maintenance Supervisor, Heat Treat Operations Manager, Quality Manager, and Plant Manager for P2, line P2-L4.

Approval actions:
- Maintenance Supervisor to confirm MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2 has been updated and scheduling configured.
- Heat Treat Operations Manager to confirm SOP-P2-L4-01 pre-run checklist has been updated and the team briefed.
- Quality Manager to confirm SOP-P2-L4-02 escalation paths are clear and record retention meets audit requirements.
- Plant Manager for P2, line P2-L4 to authorize the change and confirm resources for training and any tooling support.

Related documents
-----------------
MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2  
SOP-P2-L4-01  
SOP-P2-L4-02

Change control notes
--------------------
This ECN captures the formal change to calibration practice for EQ-P2-L4-HT02. Implementation will be monitored and reported in the next maintenance review cycle. Any need to adjust the interval or related procedures must be submitted as a follow-up ECN with supporting data from calibration trends and process capability analyses.
